rules.rule_title: Short title and commencement
rules.required_declaration: Compliance with Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.validation_condition: Applicable across all retail and wholesale pre-packed commodities sold or distributed in India.
rules.source: Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (i)
rules.penal_provision: Section 18 & Section 36 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009

rules.rule_title: Retail Package and Principal Display Panel Definitions
rules.required_declaration: Identified Principal Display Panel (PDP) intended for retail sale
rules.validation_condition: Package classified as retail package intended for consumer use.
rules.exception_condition: Packages > 25 kg/L or wholesale packs under Chapter III

rules.rule_title: Application of Chapter II to retail packages
rules.required_declaration: Declarations under Chapter II
rules.validation_condition: Package net quantity <= 25 kg or 25 L (or 50 kg for fertilizer/cement) intended for retail.
rules.exception_condition: Packages intended for industrial or institutional consumers

rules.rule_title: Regulation for pre-packing and sale of commodities in packaged form
rules.required_declaration: Securely affixed statutory label with mandatory declarations
rules.validation_condition: No person shall pre-pack or cause to be pre-packed for sale, distribution or delivery any commodity unless securely labelled with mandatory declarations.
rules.penal_provision: Section 36(1) (Fine up to ₹25,000 for first offence)

rules.rule_title: Rationalized standard package sizes (Second Schedule)
rules.required_declaration: Conformity to rationalized net quantity pack sizes
rules.validation_condition: Commodities specified in the Second Schedule must be packed in prescribed quantities, or state Unit Sale Price if un-rationalized.
rules.exception_condition: Exempt if non-scheduled or accompanied by compliant Unit Sale Price declaration

rules.rule_title: Name and complete address of manufacturer / packer / importer with PIN code
rules.required_declaration: Name and complete postal address including 6-digit postal PIN code
rules.validation_condition: Manufacturer/packer/importer name and complete address must be prominent and distinct, containing valid 6-digit postal PIN code.

rules.rule_title: Common or generic name of commodity
rules.required_declaration: Common, commercial or generic name of the commodity on PDP
rules.validation_condition: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be prominently declared on the Principal Display Panel.

rules.rule_title: Net quantity in standard SI metric units
rules.required_declaration: Net quantity expressed in legal metric SI units ('g', 'kg', 'ml', 'l', 'm', 'cm', 'N')
rules.validation_condition: Net quantity shall be declared in standard SI metric units. Non-SI units like 'gms', 'kgs', 'gm' are strictly prohibited.

rules.rule_title: Month and year of manufacture, packing or import
rules.required_declaration: Month and year of manufacture or pre-packing (MM/YYYY)
rules.validation_condition: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be clearly mentioned.
rules.exception_condition: Exempt for packages <= 10g or 10ml, or non-perishable raw agricultural products

rules.rule_title: Best before or expiry date for perishable items
rules.required_declaration: Expiry date or 'Best Before' period declaration
rules.validation_condition: Mandatory for commodities that may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time.
rules.exception_condition: Not applicable to durable non-perishable consumer durables / electronics / hardware

rules.rule_title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) with statutory '(inclusive of all taxes)' phrase
rules.required_declaration: MRP in Indian Rupees with uniform statutory phrase '(inclusive of all taxes)'
rules.validation_condition: Retail sale price of package declared as Maximum or Max. Retail Price Rs. or ₹ ... (inclusive of all taxes). No extra charging permitted.

rules.rule_title: Consumer Care contact details (Helpline, Email, Address)
rules.required_declaration: Name, address, telephone number and email address for consumer complaints
rules.validation_condition: Mandatory declaration of name, address, telephone number and email of person or office to be contacted for consumer grievances.

rules.rule_title: Batch, lot or code number for traceability
rules.required_declaration: Batch / Lot / Code number inscribed on label
rules.validation_condition: Package must bear a lot, batch or code number for manufacturing traceability.
rules.exception_condition: Exempt if package is very small (<= 10g or 10ml) and exempt under Rule 26

rules.rule_title: Unit Sale Price (USP) declaration requirement and exemption
rules.required_declaration: Unit sale price declared in Rupees per g / kg / ml / l / unit
rules.validation_condition: Mandatory for packages containing more than 100g or 100ml. Rounded to nearest two decimal places.
rules.exception_condition: Statutorily exempt for packages with net quantity <= 100g or <= 100ml (Rule 6(11) Proviso)

rules.rule_title: Principal Display Panel area and minimum font/numeral height (Table I)
rules.required_declaration: Numeral height complying with Table I schedule based on PDP area
rules.validation_condition: Height of numerals declared on PDP must meet Table I minimums (e.g., area <= 50 cm²: 1.0mm; 50-100 cm²: 1.5mm; 100-500 cm²: 2.0mm; 500-2500 cm²: 4.0mm; >2500 cm²: 6.0mm).

rules.rule_title: Declaration where to appear and clear margin space
rules.required_declaration: Mandatory declarations grouped clearly with clear space surrounding them
rules.validation_condition: Every declaration must appear in a prominent position on the principal display panel with distinct clear surrounding space without graphic clutter.

rules.rule_title: Manner in which declaration shall be made (contrast and visibility)
rules.required_declaration: High contrast between declaration text and background
rules.validation_condition: Declarations must be legible, conspicuous, and printed in distinct color contrasting with the background of the label or container.

rules.rule_title: Declaration of name and address of the manufacturer / packer / importer
rules.required_declaration: Complete postal address specifying factory or registered office
rules.validation_condition: Complete address must include state and 6-digit postal PIN code.

rules.rule_title: General provisions relating to declaration of quantity (prohibited 'when packed')
rules.required_declaration: Unconditional net quantity declaration without qualifying words
rules.validation_condition: No expression qualifying quantity such as 'when packed', 'approximate', or similar words shall be used.

rules.rule_title: Manner in which quantity shall be declared (dimension matching)
rules.required_declaration: Physical quantity expressed in correct dimension (mass for solids, volume for liquids)
rules.validation_condition: Commodity sold by mass shall be declared in terms of mass; liquid sold by volume shall be declared in volume; items sold by length/number in length/number.

rules.rule_title: Statement of units of weight, measure or number
rules.required_declaration: Use of authorized international SI metric symbols
rules.validation_condition: Units shall be expressed in international standard SI symbols ('g', 'kg', 'ml', 'l', 'm', 'cm'). Pluralizations like 'gms', 'kgs', 'mls' are strictly prohibited.

rules.rule_title: Declarations on combinations and group packages
rules.required_declaration: Individual commodity names, quantities and total package price
rules.validation_condition: When distinct commodities are combined, each commodity and its quantity must be declared alongside composite MRP.

rules.rule_title: Declarations on multi-piece packages
rules.required_declaration: Number of individual pieces and quantity per individual piece
rules.validation_condition: Total number of items and net weight/measure of each individual item declared.
rules.exception_condition: Not applicable to single unit packages

rules.rule_title: Declarations on wholesale packages (Chapter III)
rules.required_declaration: Wholesale package declarations
rules.validation_condition: Packages intended for sale to intermediaries declared with wholesale parameters.
rules.exception_condition: Retail consumer packages governed by Chapter II

rules.rule_title: Manner of declaration on wholesale packages
rules.required_declaration: Legible inscription on outer carton or container
rules.validation_condition: Declarations on wholesale packages clearly printed on outer transport packaging.

rules.rule_title: Provisions relating to wholesale dealer and retail dealer compliance
rules.required_declaration: No alteration, smudging, or obscuring of mandatory declarations
rules.validation_condition: No wholesale dealer or retail dealer shall alter, obliterate or smudge any declaration specified under these rules.

rules.rule_title: Inspection of quantity and examination of packages
rules.required_declaration: Statutory inspection protocols and sample testing procedures
rules.validation_condition: Officers empowered to enter, inspect, seize non-compliant packaging and test net contents.
rules.source: Rule 19 read with Section 15 of Act

rules.rule_title: Action to be taken on non-compliant packages during inspection
rules.required_declaration: Notice of seizure and compounding under statutory forms
rules.validation_condition: Where packages fail statutory declarations, officer shall seize samples and issue statutory notice.

rules.rule_title: Maximum permissible errors (MPE) on net quantity (First Schedule)
rules.required_declaration: Package weight/volume within First Schedule Maximum Permissible Error tolerances
rules.validation_condition: Net quantity shall not be deficient beyond the maximum permissible error specified in First Schedule.

rules.rule_title: Establishment of maximum permissible error and test procedures
rules.required_declaration: Conformity to gravimetric and volumetric standard test methods
rules.validation_condition: Net contents verified using calibrated test scales and standard weights.

rules.rule_title: Disposal of seized packages after compounding or adjudication
rules.required_declaration: Statutory return or confiscation of seized inventory
rules.validation_condition: Seized packages dealt with in accordance with Section 15 of the Act.

rules.rule_title: Sampling protocols and statistical sample size selection
rules.required_declaration: Batch sample sizes conforming to statutory sampling tables
rules.validation_condition: Representative statistical sampling based on batch population size.

rules.rule_title: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
rules.required_declaration: Registration certificate issued by Director or Controller of Legal Metrology
rules.validation_condition: Every pre-packer, manufacturer, or importer shall register their name and premises with the Director/Controller.

rules.rule_title: Exemptions for small packages and specific commodities
rules.applicable_category: Packages <= 10g or 10ml, hotel packs, fast food wraps
rules.required_declaration: Exemption qualification under Rule 26 clauses
rules.validation_condition: Packages containing net weight <= 10g or <= 10ml, or packages for hotel hospitality exempt from specified declarations.
rules.exception_condition: Exempted from specified declarations if net quantity <= 10g/ml

rules.rule_title: Registration fees and application particulars
rules.required_declaration: Payment of statutory registration fees
rules.validation_condition: Application for registration accompanied by prescribed statutory fee.

rules.rule_title: Maintenance of register and certificates of registration
rules.required_declaration: Official register of pre-packers and importers
rules.validation_condition: Central registry maintained by Director of Legal Metrology.

rules.rule_title: Grant of certificate of registration
rules.required_declaration: Valid certificate of registration under Legal Metrology Rules
rules.validation_condition: Form of registration certificate issued to applicant.

rules.rule_title: Appeal against order of Controller or Legal Metrology Officer
rules.required_declaration: Right of statutory appeal within thirty days
rules.validation_condition: Appeals against compounding, notices, or refusal of registration lie with the State Government / Central Director.

rules.rule_title: Procedure for hearing of appeal
rules.required_declaration: Principles of natural justice and reasoned appellate orders
rules.validation_condition: Appellate procedures followed as per prescribed timetable.

rules.rule_title: Fine for contravention of rules where no specific penalty is provided
rules.required_declaration: General penalty clause
rules.validation_condition: Whoever contravenes any provision of these rules for which no punishment is provided in the Act shall be punished with fine up to ₹5,000.

rules.rule_title: Compounding of offences under Section 48 of the Act
rules.required_declaration: Compounding fee schedule
rules.validation_condition: Offences under Section 36(1) for violation of Rule 6 declarations compoundable at ₹25,000 (first offence) or ₹50,000 (second offence).

rules.rule_title: Power to relax provisions of rules in public interest
rules.required_declaration: Central Government relaxation notification
rules.validation_condition: Central Government may relax rules in bona fide circumstances of unforeseen hardship.

rules.rule_title: Repeal of Standards of Weights and Measures (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 1977 and savings
rules.required_declaration: Continuity of statutory actions taken under 1977 rules
rules.validation_condition: 1977 Rules repealed; actions taken deemed saved under 2011 Rules.
